The '''Bajic sector''', also known as '''Baji sector''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Planets included [[Talofan]], [[Verisin]], [[Yasilor]], and [[Sperin]]. Bajic also contained the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]]. Bajic was, during the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Fema Baab/Legends|Fema Baab]].<ref name="DB" /> During the rule of the Galactic Empire, the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was governed by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Kintaro]].<ref name="CSWE-Kintaro">{{CSWECite|II|219|Kintaro, Grand Moff}}</ref>

The Bajic sector was also home to the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Criminal Syndicate]]. [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] ran [[Spice/Legends|spice]] operations there as well.
